graph.num_nodes: <int> Number of nodes in the undirected network.
graph.num_edges: <int> Number of edges in the undirected network.

depot: <int> Node where all vehicles start and end their routes.

fleet.num_vehicles: <int> Number of identical vehicles available in the fleet.
fleet.vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total demand that a single vehicle can service on its route.

num_required_edges: <int> Number of edges that must be serviced.
total_demand: <int> Sum of demands across all required edges.

edges.endpoints: <list[int], length 2> The two nodes connected by this edge.
edges.cost: <int> Cost incurred each time a vehicle traverses this edge without servicing it.
edges.is_required: <bool> Whether this edge must be serviced by exactly one vehicle.
edges.demand: <int> Amount of capacity consumed when a vehicle services this edge (0 if not required).
edges.service_cost: <int> Cost incurred when a vehicle services this edge (0 if not required).
